name: workshop-pglite
description: Shared PGlite-over-socket database for the workshop. Boots in-process Postgres (WASM) on 127.0.0.1:5432, seeded with RAGmonsters (30 monsters across 9 normalized tables). Used by step-02 (deprecated official pg-mcp) and step-03 (custom v2 server) — same database, different servers.
